description: This file defines the RelatedProduct class, which extends the Product class and implements Serializable. It includes a field for the relationship type between products and its getter and setter methods.

classes.name: RelatedProduct
classes.description: A Java class representing a related product, extending Product and supporting serialization. Contains a relationship type attribute with associated getter and setter methods.

methods.name: setRelationShipType
methods.description: Sets the type of relationship between products.

methods.name: getRelationShipType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of relationship between products.
